benchmark.notes: each metric once per sim over the scored frames and all channels, then the plain mean over sims; vrmse, h1 and h2 are per field then mean; h1/h2 are relative seminorm errors (1 = flat prediction); ssim is 1 - SSIM; prediction and target clamped to [-1, 1] if clamp_prediction

benchmark_10.notes: each metric once per sim over the scored frames and all channels, then the plain mean over sims; vrmse, h1 and h2 are per field then mean; h1/h2 are relative seminorm errors (1 = flat prediction); ssim is 1 - SSIM; prediction and target clamped to [-1, 1] if clamp_prediction

shock_analysis.notes: regions from the ground truth: shock = top top_frac of |grad log p|, shock_band = shock dilated by dilate_px minus shock, contact = top top_frac of |grad log rho| dilated, outside the dilated shock, smooth = rest. Regions on the scored frames, same clamp as the benchmark block; rmse in normalized space; se_share = region's share of the channel's squared error; concentration = se_share_chmean / area_frac. Tokens: latent frames before first_free_latent (the condition) left out.
